name: 网页搜索 / 正文读取
author: flycat666
description: 给模型追加 web_search / web_read / web_search_multi 三个工具：用真实（无头）浏览器搜五个搜索引擎（bing/baidu/google/duckduckgo/zhihu），并把网页正文抽成 markdown。依赖本机的 web_search 项目 + playwright + chromium，见同目录 README.md。

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web with a real (headless) browser and get JSON back: position/title/link/snippet/source per result, plus an optional 'warning' field when a search engine looks degraded. Use it whenever the answer depends on current facts — library versions, release dates, prices, news, API docs — instead of answering from memory. Default engine is bing (most reliable). After searching, open the promising links with web_read rather than guessing from the snippet.

query.description: What to search for. Keep it short — it is typed into a search box, not into a prompt.

engine.description: Search engine to use. bing = default and most reliable; baidu/zhihu for Chinese-language content; google/duckduckgo for English.

max.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10).

pages.description: How many result pages to scrape (default 1). Each extra page costs a few seconds.

domain.description: Keep only results whose link contains this domain, e.g. 'docs.python.org'. Useful for official docs.

fallback.description: Engine(s) to retry when the first one returns nothing: comma separated ('bing,google') or 'auto' to try the rest in default order.

headless.description: Run the browser without a window. Default true — leave it alone unless you are watching the screen.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Open one URL in a real (headless) browser and return its main article text as markdown (navigation, ads and sidebars stripped). Use it right after web_search to actually read a promising result — snippets are not enough for facts, code or version numbers. Long pages are truncated to max_chars, so raise it only when you need a later part of the page.

format.description: markdown keeps headings/links/code blocks (default); text is plain and slightly cheaper.

max_chars.description: Truncate the extracted text to this many characters (default 8000). The host cuts any tool result over 32KB, and Chinese text is ~3 bytes per character, so keep it under ~10000.

wait_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before extracting — needed for JS-rendered (SPA) pages, e.g. 'article' or '.markdown-body'.

scroll.description: Scroll to the bottom first to trigger lazy-loaded content (default false).

tools.name: web_search_multi
tools.description: Search several keywords in one browser session (batch web_search; ~2s between queries). Prefer this over calling web_search N times when you have a fixed list of things to check, since it starts the browser once.

queries.description: Keywords to search, one per entry (max 8).

engine.description: Search engine for all queries. Default bing.
